description: Static scan of SpectraCQ v1.0 Cypher queries confirming all 137 are schema-level patterns directly translatable to SPARQL via the released OWL TTL (no Neo4j-only constructs).
methodology_note: All 137 queries use only SPARQL-equivalent constructs: graph patterns, single-hop directed edges, property filters, and standard aggregates (count, avg, collect, case). None use apoc.* procedures, variable-length paths >0 hops, shortestPath, or method-chain string operations. SPARQL translation is a direct mapping using the same OWL TBox; 6 representative SPARQL examples are bundled at queries/sparql/.
